summary: Verified font-proxy CORS fix end-to-end. All 5 assertions pass: (1) /api/public/font/{id} returns 200 TTF with Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* and 404 for bogus id; (2) overlay HTML @font-face points to /api/public/font/{id} with ZERO raw your-objectstorage.com references; (3) overlay page in real browser: document.fonts.ready completes, document.fonts.check("100px 'BebasNeue'") === true, 'BebasNeue' entry status='loaded', BEBASCHECK renders in condensed BebasNeue typeface (visually confirmed in screenshot); (4) /fonts page logged in shows BebasNeue card with 'AA BB 123' preview rendered in BebasNeue (loaded in document.fonts); (5) Scene editor font picker (data-testid=prop-font) opens, lists BebasNeue under 'YOUR FONTS' group with checkmark, canvas preview renders BEBASCHECK in BebasNeue typeface.

issues: Repeated console warning: color input value '#111' not conforming to '#rrggbb' format. Cosmetic only; expand to #111111.

critical_code_review_comments: Font proxy correctly streams S3 bytes with ACAO:* and font/ttf content-type; cache-control is no-store which is safe but could be relaxed to public/immutable for perf since font ids are stable.
Minor: color inputs in ElementInspector should normalise 3-char hex (#111) to 6-char (#111111) before binding to <input type='color'> to silence browser warnings.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Font CORS bug fully resolved. Overlay @font-face uses same-origin proxy /api/public/font/{id} which returns ACAO:*. Browser-side document.fonts.check confirms custom font loads in overlay — the previously broken flow is now green. Only minor cosmetic console warning (#111 color input) found; unrelated to font bug.
rca of the issue: Original bug: @font-face src pointed at Hetzner S3 (your-objectstorage.com) which omits Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so the browser aborted the cross-origin font fetch inside overlay/editor and fell back to default sans-serif. Fix: added public backend proxy GET /api/public/font/{font_id} that streams bytes with ACAO:* (same origin as the overlay HTML). Both _font_faces_css server-side and injectFontFaces client-side now build src from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /api/public/font/{id}. Verified: 0 occurrences of your-objectstorage.com in overlay HTML, document.fonts loads BebasNeue, visual rendering is condensed BebasNeue.
